tutorials.title: How to make this open-world loading screen of your city using Claude

Claude builds it, you tweak it

Claude builds it, you tweak it

tutorials.title: How to make this animated advent calendar using Claude

Claude builds it, you tweak it

Claude builds it, you tweak it

tutorials.title: How to make this turkey charcuterie board video using Higgsfield

Turn it into a video with a slow build-up camera move
Higgsfield builds it, you tweak it
